findings.evidence: Lines 166, 207, and 218 respectively reduce the defining predicate on a permutation diagram and both reconstruction round trips; adjacent value/application rules already use `@[simp]`.

summary: The public constructions have characteristic laws, but several canonical reduction and inverse laws are missing simp annotations.
